payload.text: (hv, 2026-11-26, in devbin-vc's window; relayed by devbin-vc at 06:45Z on its date -u; not heard first-hand by vc) The arca_swift 0.3.0 bump STAYS in 3.5.4 as a plain dependency move, as bed2fdc44's CHANGELOG line states.
